revision_history.aborted_v67_0_reason: pre-result red team found geometry-pooled lambda selection, a shared dual/direct-field lambda, and non-independent execution-ledger auditing
v67_1_corrections: select each learned control lambda from the maximum geometry-by-metric-by-reference p90-higher and worst rather than pooled geometry rows
select dual-space and direct-field lambdas independently under the same p14 five-fold firewall
independently count exact forward and adjoint calls at validator call sites and compare phase totals
add Zero-CGLS K1 and assert every row budget against the frozen arm declaration
limit all Stage-B cost language to exact A and A-transpose calls

scientific_question: Do the unchanged v66 q8-K1 and q4-K2 exact-lift warm starts retain matched field, gradient, and observation accuracy over every frame of five already-open PoolFire trajectories and three frozen known straight-ray geometries, while remaining non-dominated by controls with equal-or-lower exact A and A-transpose call budgets?
evidence_role: full-trajectory compatibility and control-dominance gate on already-open public CFD morphology under the frozen noise-free nine-view known straight-ray proxy; not a fresh trajectory, curved-ray, calibrated-camera, experimental BOST, wall-time, memory, independent-family, broad-generalization, novelty, or paper-success result

data_contract.selection_trajectory_role: already-open development model-selection trajectory used only to choose one global linear-kernel ridge lambda before fit-trajectory scoring; it is not independent, fresh, blind, or confirmatory
data_contract.axis_mapping: transpose each gauge_truth frame from (x,y,z) to (z,y,x)
data_contract.support_and_gauge: zero one-voxel outer boundary, subtract the support-positive mean, then reapply support
data_contract.observation_generation: noise-free y=Ag*x from the exact frozen target operator; historical pair observations are forbidden
data_contract.fit_trajectory_training_firewall: for every scored fit trajectory, any fitted dual-ridge control is trained on the other four fit trajectories only; the scored trajectory contributes no input, truth, teacher, normalization, kernel, or coefficient

geometry_contract.source: copy exactly formal_geometry, geometry_patterns, and scenario_generators from the frozen v66.1 protocol
geometry_contract.exact_operator: matrix-free sparse trilinear ray stencil plus frozen voxel-gradient operator
geometry_contract.factor_family: reuse the exact v66 randomized q8 factors and immutable q4 prefix without rank, seed, oversampling, power-iteration, or detector-CR changes

fixed_controls.family: exact backprojection with observable-only least-squares scalar and cached projection
scaled exact backprojection followed by unchanged exact CGLS
scaled exact backprojection followed by unchanged exact CGLS
zero-start exact PCGLS with fixed geometry-only Jacobi inverse
zero-start exact PCGLS with fixed geometry-only Jacobi inverse
zero-start exact PCGLS with fixed geometry-only Jacobi inverse
unchanged v66 analytic straight-geometry detector proposal with exact Ag lift
leave-one-fit-trajectory-out normalized linear kernel ridge from observation to the natural Zero-K4 detector dual, exact Ag-transpose lift, unchanged exact CGLS K1
same frozen leave-one-fit-trajectory-out dual proposal followed by unchanged exact CGLS K2
same leave-one-fit-trajectory-out normalized linear kernel ridge, but predicting the Zero-K4 field directly before unchanged exact CGLS K1
same leave-one-fit-trajectory-out normalized linear kernel ridge direct-field proposal followed by unchanged exact CGLS K2

jacobi_contract.diagonal: exact sum of squared columns of every view-component target-geometry operator block
jacobi_contract.normalization: median positive diagonal divided by max(diagonal, relative_floor*maximum_positive)
jacobi_contract.zero_sensitivity_handling: replace by the same positive floor

dual_ridge_contract.teacher: the natural detector-space dual accumulated by zero-start exact CGLS K4, satisfying Ag-transpose*z_teacher=x_K4 to numerical tolerance
dual_ridge_contract.sample_amplitude_equivariance: divide observation and teacher dual by ||y||_2 during fit and multiply predicted dual by the deployment observation norm
dual_ridge_contract.lambda_selection: five contiguous held-out blocks on p=14kw_size=01; for each lambda first compute p90-higher and worst separately in every geometry x metric x reference stratum, then choose one global dual-space lambda by lexicographically minimizing the maximum stratum p90-higher, maximum stratum worst, and negative lambda; ties choose the larger lambda
dual_ridge_contract.fit_evaluation: after lambda freeze, fit five models per geometry; each model uses all 101 frames from the other four fit trajectories and scores only the omitted trajectory
dual_ridge_contract.prediction: kernel coefficients times normalized teacher duals, followed by one exact Ag-transpose lift
dual_ridge_contract.direct_field_capacity_control: the identical folds, lambda grid, normalization, linear kernel and Zero-K4 teachers predict the Zero-K4 field directly; its own global lambda is selected independently with the same geometry-stratified objective, so this fairly separates dual-representation value from generic linear regression value

metric_contract.field: relative L2 to supported gauge-fixed truth
metric_contract.gradient: relative L2 of physical-spacing np.gradient in z,y,x, edge_order=2 over the full volume
metric_contract.interior_gradient: the same gradient error restricted to [:,2:-2,2:-2,2:-2], excluding the artificial zero-support boundary and its immediate derivative influence
metric_contract.boundary_shell_gradient: the same gradient error on the complement of the frozen interior mask; descriptive only
metric_contract.cell_harm: stabilized candidate absolute error divided by Zero-K4 absolute error
metric_contract.equal_call_ratio: stabilized candidate absolute error divided by Zero-K2 or Zero-K3 at the same exact A/AT depth
metric_contract.reported_overall: retain all 15 trajectory-by-geometry strata; across five trajectories report only the five values, their median, and maximum; no frame is treated as an independent trajectory
metric_contract.degenerate_norm_action: fail closed; never skip or exclude the frame
metric_contract.harm_ratio_floor: 1e-12 times the corresponding frozen truth or observation norm

stage_b_gate.primary_must_not_be_globally_dominated: no declared control with exact A and A-transpose counts each no greater may have field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, and observation absolute errors no greater in every one of 1515 cells with at least one strict improvement; this is not a total wall-time or memory cost claim
stage_b_gate.primary_layer_tail_rule: no eligible control may Pareto-dominate the primary in both p90-higher and worst over field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, and observation in all 15 trajectory-by-geometry strata

failure_action: If q8 fails any frozen cell gate or is globally dominated by an equal-or-cheaper control, do not run the fresh resource gate and do not enlarge rank or train a neural rescue; record the negative result and pivot to the best surviving classical or linear control. If q8 passes, only the frozen fresh resource gate is authorized next.
